Name: Luny's Simple Head Scarf for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Ffvnd3.png[/img]

[center]A simple mod that adds a simple fashion accessory.
Goes great with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23925]farm dresses[/url]﻿ mod! :D

I modeled this according to the hairstyles in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24746]salon mod[/url]﻿, but I'm hoping it'll fit with other hairstyles as well.





[img]https://i.imgur.com/B92L7co.png[/img]﻿
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿!
Unzip the file and drop the folder, [FS] Luny's Head Scarf, into your StardewValley/mods folder.
It'll now appear in the Fashion Sense menu.[/center]
